newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - MIXED FORTUNES ON NSE.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - MIXED FORTUNES ON NSE.

text.p: Sentra Namibia on Friday,
August 23, announced a giant tripling in profits in the six
months to June 30.
Two weeks ago the share price climbed to N$4.25, where it
continued to trade last week.
But Metje & Ziegler warned the same day that earlier
projections had been reversed and results for their year to June
30 would show a "substantial overall loss."
The mixed fortunes were typical of a busy week on the
Namibian Stock Exchange (NSE), with trading in a wide range of
different shares.
South African leather and meat processing group Kolosus
Holdings was hotly in demand, while other action focused on
South African investment trust Genbel South Africa and life
assurers Southern Life and Metropolitan Life.
Namibia Breweries registered the biggest volume of shares
traded in a Namibian firm.
Trading during the week was worth N$6.7 million, for a total
volume of 448,573 shares traded. The (NSE) overall undex closed
on Friday at 228.93 up a little on the previous week's 226.77.
The NSE local index reached 157.54, also slightly up on the
previous week's 156.58.
-- Johannesburg newsroom 27 11 482 1003
